sentences.text: Er hielt das Buch in der Hand.
sentences.en: He was holding the book in his hand.

sentences.text: Der Bus hielt vor dem Haus.
sentences.en: The bus stopped in front of the house.

sentences.text: Der Zug hielt nicht in München.
sentences.en: The train didn't stop in Munich.

sentences.text: Das Auto hielt vor der Tür.
sentences.en: The car stopped at the door.

meanings.gloss: halten für: took for, considered; halten von: thought of

sentences.text: Ich hielt ihn für einen Freund.
sentences.en: I thought he was a friend.

sentences.text: Sie hielt das für eine gute Idee.
sentences.en: She thought that was a good idea.

sentences.text: Er hielt mich für meinen Bruder.
sentences.en: He took me for my brother.

sentences.text: Er hielt nicht viel von der Idee.
sentences.en: He didn't think much of the idea.
She didn't think much of him at all.
sentences.review: 'Sie hielt nichts von ihm' means she had no regard for him at all; 'She didn't think much of him at all' is a mixed, slightly confusing phrasing. Suggest 'She thought nothing of him' or 'She had no time for him.'
